mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_played, COALESCE(MAX(play_time_seconds), 0) AS play_time_seconds, COALESCE(MAX(correct_count), 0) AS correct_count FROM daily_game_log WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND played_date = #{targetDate} AND is_valid = TRUE

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(dq.daily_question_log_id) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_answered, MAX(qb.question_text) AS question_text FROM daily_question_log dq JOIN question_bank qb ON dq.question_id = qb.question_id WHERE dq.member_id = #{memberId} AND dq.record_date = #{targetDate} AND dq.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_written, MAX(sleep_level) AS sleep_level, MAX(sleep_memo) AS sleep_memo, MAX(mood_level) AS mood_level, MAX(mood_memo) AS mood_memo, MAX(meal_level) AS meal_level, MAX(meal_memo) AS meal_memo, MAX(exercise_level) AS exercise_level, MAX(exercise_memo) AS exercise_memo, MAX(social_level) AS social_level, MAX(social_memo) AS social_memo FROM daily_record WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND record_date = #{targetDate}
